text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If it's Nakayama Festa, she might be able 
to get even closer to the "top of the 
world" than El Condor Pasa—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her victory instilled hope in the public. 
Enough to make them eagerly anticipate a 
bright future a year from now... and truly 
yearn to "see it."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The ticket entrusted by El Condor Pasa. 
The destination is a place no one has 
reached yet. It will likely take time to 
attain that level of formidable greatness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, we will surely reach it. There is 
no place for a world devoid of romance. 
—With the light of hope in our hearts, let 
us forge the future.
